issue.name: SQL Injection
issue.issueBackground: SQL injection vulnerabilities arise when user-controllable data is incorporated into database SQL queries in an unsafe manner.
issue.issueDetail: The parameter q appears to be vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. The payload ' OR '1'='1 was submitted.

requestresponse.request: GET /search.php?q=test'+OR+'1'%3D'1&submit=Search HTTP/1.1 Host: testphp.vulnweb.com User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 Accept: text/html
requestresponse.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html
<html>Results: admin, user1, user2</html>

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueDetail: The parameter cat is vulnerable to reflected XSS. Payload: <script>alert(1)</script>

issue.name: Open redirection (reflected)
issue.issueDetail: The url parameter is used in an HTTP redirect without validation.

issue.name: Password field submitted using GET method
issue.issueDetail: The password field is transmitted via GET request, exposing it in logs and history.

requestresponse.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html
Welcome admin!

issue.name: SQL Injection (second order)
issue.issueDetail: Second-order SQL injection detected in email field of user update endpoint.

requestresponse.request:
POST /api/user/update HTTP/1.1 Host: testphp.vulnweb.com Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
user_id=5&email=test%40test.com'--&token=abc123

issue.name: Path traversal
issue.issueDetail: The file parameter is vulnerable to path traversal. ../../etc/passwd was accessible.
